name: cache-expiry-notifier
description: Notifies you X minutes before your prompt cache expires so you can send a turn before paying the full re-cache cost.

warnMinutes.title: Warn before expiry (minutes)
warnMinutes.description: How many minutes before cache expiry to fire the alert. Minimum 1.

cacheTtl.title: Cache lifetime override
cacheTtl.description: auto (default) detects the TTL from Claude's responses. Set 5m or 1h to override.

minTokens.title: Minimum tokens to warn
minTokens.description: Only fire the alert when the session holds at least this many tokens. Below this, re-caching is cheap enough to ignore.
